---
title: "glmnetUI Model Report"
output:
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: xelatex
mainfont: "Roboto Condensed"
sansfont: "Roboto Condensed"
params:
  appraiser_name: ""
  property_address: ""
  report_date: ""
  file_number: ""
  lambda: 0
  lambda_min: NA
  lambda_1se: NA
  coef_df: NULL
  plot_dir: ""
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

## Report Information

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Appraiser | `r params$appraiser_name` |
| Property | `r params$property_address` |
| Date | `r params$report_date` |
| File Number | `r params$file_number` |

## Model Summary

- **Lambda selected:** `r signif(params$lambda, 4)`
```{r lambda-details, results='asis'}
if (!is.na(params$lambda_min)) {
  cat(sprintf("- **lambda.min:** %s\n", signif(params$lambda_min, 4)))
  cat(sprintf("- **lambda.1se:** %s\n", signif(params$lambda_1se, 4)))
}
```

## Coefficient Table

```{r coef-table}
if (!is.null(params$coef_df)) {
  knitr::kable(params$coef_df, row.names = FALSE,
               col.names = c("Variable", "Coefficient", "Sign Warning"))
}
```

## Diagnostic Plots

```{r coef-path, fig.cap="Coefficient Path"}
f <- file.path(params$plot_dir, "coef_path.png")
if (file.exists(f)) knitr::include_graphics(f)
```

```{r cv-error, fig.cap="Cross-Validation Error"}
f <- file.path(params$plot_dir, "cv_error.png")
if (file.exists(f)) knitr::include_graphics(f)
```

```{r avp, fig.cap="Actual vs Predicted"}
f <- file.path(params$plot_dir, "actual_vs_predicted.png")
if (file.exists(f)) knitr::include_graphics(f)
```

```{r resid, fig.cap="Residuals vs Fitted"}
f <- file.path(params$plot_dir, "residuals_vs_fitted.png")
if (file.exists(f)) knitr::include_graphics(f)
```
